'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2025 Sumy airstrike]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]] leader [[Volodymyr Artyukh]] is fired from his position as [[Sumy Oblast]] Governor following condemnation for organizing a [[Military tradition|military ceremony]] in the densely populated [[Sumy]] city center, which was later targeted by a [[Russia|Russian]] [[Airstrike|airstrike]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/government-backs-dismissal-of-sumy-luhansk-oblasts-governors/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]], [[Foreign aid to Sudan]]
**[[Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war]]
***The [[European Union]] and its [[Member states of the European Union|member states]] pledge {{Euro}}522 million (US$590 million) and the [[United Kingdom]] pledges {{GBP}}120 million (US$141 million) in [[humanitarian aid]] to [[Sudan]] to deliver food and supplies to over 650,000 [[internal displacement|internally displaced]] [[Sudanese people]] affected by the fighting between the [[Rapid Support Forces]] and the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]]. The two groups also call for an immediate [[ceasefire]] to end the war. [https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-eu-and-uk-pledge-millions-in-aid-at-london-conference/a-72246642 (DW)] [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-war-humanitarian-aid-international-conference-3f88dcd4422c9dea3d0da1b3bbfdbf40 (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**At least three [[Balochistan Police]] officers are killed and 16 others are injured when a [[roadside bomb]] hits a [[bus]] carrying police personnel in [[Mastung District]], [[Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/pakistan-blast-kills-3-police-officers-in-balochistan/a-72247584 (DW)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[China–United States trade war]]
***[[China]] orders its airlines to stop taking deliveries of jets from American aviation company [[Boeing]] and to suspend purchases of aircraft-related equipment and parts from U.S. companies. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/us-china-trade-war-escalates-beijing-suspends-boeing-jet-deliveries-8168805 (NDTV)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 3,747 people are hospitalized with breathing difficulties and [[airport]]s are closed after a [[dust storm]] in [[Iraq]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250415-iraq-sandstorm-closes-airports-puts-3-700-people-in-hospital (France 24)]
*A [[Chinese people|Chinese]] crew member is killed when [[China|Chinese]] [[sand]] [[barge]] vessel ''M/V Hong Hai 16'' capsizes off [[Rizal, Occidental Mindoro|Rizal]], [[Occidental Mindoro]], [[Philippines]]. A [[search and rescue]] operation is launched by the [[Philippine Coast Guard]] for missing crew members, which includes seven [[Filipinos]] and three Chinese. [https://www.philstar.com/nation/2025/04/16/2436473/search-ongoing-7-filipinos-3-chinese-after-vessel-capsizes-occidental-mindoro/ (''The Philippine Star'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[European Commission]] approves the use of [[Lecanemab]], a [[monoclonal antibody]] medication that targets [[amyloid beta peptide]]s, to treat the early stages of [[Alzheimer's disease]] via [[intravenous therapy]]. This is the first drug to be approved to treat the disease in [[Europe]], and was approved by the [[Food and Drug Administration]] in the [[United States]] in 2023. [https://www.dw.com/en/lecanemab-alzheimers-therapy-approved-in-europe/a-72253945 (DW)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Algeria–France relations]]
**[[France]] expels twelve [[Algeria]]n [[diplomat|diplomatic official]]s from the country after Algeria expelled twelve French officials yesterday over the arrest of an [[Embassy of Algeria, Paris|Algerian consular official]] in a [[kidnapping]] case. France also recalls its [[Embassy of France, Algiers|ambassador]] from [[Algiers]]. [https://apnews.com/article/france-algeria-tensions-officials-expelled-09a8626acbf925733e088bc1b2f365a5 (AP)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-04-15/france-algeria-spat-escalates-with-diplomatic-staff-expelled (''Bloomberg'')]
*[[Israel–Maldives relations]], [[Visa policy of the Maldives]]
**The [[People's Majlis|Parliament]] of the [[Maldives]] votes in favor of an amendment to the [[Constitution of the Maldives|Immigration Act]], banning entry into the Maldives for those traveling on [[Israeli passport]]s. [https://edition.mv/maldives/40532 (''The Edition'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Media freedom in Russia]]
**Four [[Russia]]n [[journalist]]s linked to the late Russian [[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|opposition leader]] [[Alexei Navalny]] are convicted of [[extremism]] and sentenced to five years and six months imprisonment in a [[corrective labor colony|penal colony]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/04/15/europe/russian-journalists-sentenced-navalny-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://apnews.com/article/russia-crackdown-navalny-associates-prison-terms-6a01dd2fc50c50b0e1f765d618177e54 (AP)]
*[[Piracy in the 21st century]]
**According to a report by the [[International Maritime Bureau]], [[piracy]] has risen by almost 35% in 2025 with 45 cases in the [[calendar year#quarter year|first quarter]] compared to the same period in 2024, particularly in the [[Singapore Strait]] between [[Singapore]] and [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/piracy-on-the-rise-across-the-world-maritime-watchdog/a-72249554 (DW)] [https://www.seatrade-maritime.com/security/asian-maritime-security-in-q1-surprising-developments-in-the-singapore-strait (Seatrade Maritime News)]

**A court in [[Lima]], [[Peru]], sentences former [[President of Peru|president]] [[Ollanta Humala]] and his wife [[Nadine Heredia]] to 15 years in prison for [[money laundering|laundering funds]] from [[Brazil]]ian company [[Odebrecht]] to finance his [[2006 Peruvian general election|2006]] and [[2011 Peruvian general election|2011]] [[presidential campaign]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/peru-president-ollanta-humala-prison-sentence-c23edf1be2346ad06b9430fa0fd79ede (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c33z6kn7xvyo (BBC News)]
*At least four students are injured in a [[school shooting|school]] [[mass shooting]] at [[Wilmer-Hutchins High School]] in [[Dallas]], [[Texas]], United States. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/04/shooting-reported-at-wilmer-hutchins-high-school-in-dallas/ (BNO News)]
*Four people are injured in a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] after a person drives a sedan onto a pedestrian walkway on the [[Toronto Metropolitan University]] campus near [[Yonge Street]] and [[Gerrard Street (Toronto)|Gerrard Street]] in [[Toronto]], [[Ontario]], Canada.
